title: Shared cargo target-dir serves stale artifacts across divergent branches (phantom E0004)
description: Reproducible hazard during g9dq: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/mark/Cache/cargo-target (per ~/.cargo/config.toml 'single global cache') is shared across all Rust projects/branches. Building 'cargo test -p lichen-gateway' in that shared dir failed with E0004 'L2PayloadKind::Sos not covered' at lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:223, citing lichen-core/src/l2_payload.rs:13:4 — but current HEAD l2_payload.rs has NO Sos variant (enum is Schc/Routing/Unknown only), and 'cargo check -p lichen-node' (default AND --all-features) passes in the same shared dir. Root cause: a stale artifact from a divergent branch (one carrying an L2PayloadKind::Sos variant) poisoned the cache slot for the feature-set lichen-gateway requests for lichen-node. Confirmed cache-artifact (not source): a FRESH CARGO_TARGET_DIR builds 'cargo test -p lichen-gateway' cleanly and binding_invariant tests pass 2/2. Risk: another worker may hit the same phantom error and file a false 'broken build' bead or waste a round. Mitigation options: per-worker/per-branch target dirs, or document 'use a fresh CARGO_TARGET_DIR when a phantom compile error does not match current source' in rust/AGENTS.md build notes.
